# coval_agent (Resource)

Manages a Coval agent configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coval_agent" "support" {
  display_name = "Customer Support"
  model_type   = "MODEL_TYPE_CHAT"
  prompt       = "Help customers with product questions."

  metadata = {
    chat_endpoint = "https://api.example.com/chat"
  }

  tags = ["support", "production"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable agent name.
- `model_type` (String) Agent simulator type.

### Optional

- `attributes` (Dynamic) Free-form JSON object containing agent attributes. Set {} to clear it.
- `customer_agent_id` (String) Customer-defined external identifier. Coval defaults it to id when omitted.
- `endpoint` (String) Webhook endpoint URL used by agent types that require one.
- `language` (String) Primary language for the agent.
- `metadata` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Simulator-specific JSON configuration. The required shape depends on model_type. Set {} to clear it.
- `metric_ids` (Set of String) Metric IDs associated with the agent. Set [] to clear them.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number in E.164 format or SIP address for voice and SMS agents.
- `prompt` (String) Agent instructions or system prompt.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags associated with the agent. Set [] to clear them.
- `test_set_ids` (Set of String) Test-set IDs associated with the agent. Set [] to clear them.
- `workflows` (Dynamic) Workflow JSON configuration. Set {} to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned agent ID.
- `knowledge_base_ids` (Set of String) Knowledge-base entry IDs associated with the agent.
- `update_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the latest update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = coval_agent.support
  identity = {
    id = "abc123def456ghi789jklm"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coval_agent.support abc123def456ghi789jklm
```
